name: quality-regression
title: Implement quality gates and regression suites
description: Add contract, E2E, visual, accessibility, and responsive regression verification.
scope: backend/frontend contract, integration, E2E, accessibility, responsive, visual, credential, and immutability gates
creator: xuanyuechenfeng
notes: Implemented contract normalization, MockMvc HTTP envelopes, Redis/PostgreSQL Testcontainers gates, Vitest fixtures, Playwright web/admin journeys, axe critical/serious checks, duplicate-id/DOM-target/overflow audits, responsive visual baselines, credential scanning, theme/locale checks, and bak immutability CI. Verification passed twice: backend Maven test 39 tests with 2 Docker-dependent local skips, frontend typecheck/build/unit (5 tests) and Playwright (15 tests) passed in both runs. Chromium visual baselines were reviewed at web 1440x900/1024x768/390x844 and admin 1440x900/800x1024/390x844. Docker-dependent tests are configured to fail in CI when Docker is unavailable.
